title: Akr Random Rewards
description: Plugin for the random rewards system.
body:
EN: **AkrRwd plugin** - This is a plugin that will help you create a random rewards system and set a time after which the team will be available to your players again, this plugin also has flexible settings.

UA: **Плагін AkrRwd** – це плагін, який допоможе вам створити систему випадкових винагород та встановити час, після якого команда знову буде доступна вашим гравцям, цей плагін також має гнучкі налаштування.

PL: **Wtyczka AkrRwd** – to wtyczka, która pomoże Ci stworzyć system losowych nagród i ustalić czas, po którym drużyna będzie ponownie dostępna dla Twoich graczy. Ta wtyczka ma również 
elastyczne ustawienia.

**Plugin features:**

- Gradient colors support (```<GRADIENT:#084CFB>your text</GRADIENT:#0024FF>```)

- Tab-Completion support

- Supported localizations: ua - (Ukrainian), en - (English), pl - (Poland)

- Changing cooldown for players without leaving the game

- Ability to reset cooldown without leaving the game

- Support for displaying title (Configurable in config.yml)

- Support for displaying subtitle (Configurable in messages.yml)

- Support for displaying actionbar (Configurable in messages.yml)

- Display your cooldown in bossbar (/akrrwd toggle)

- Support bossbar costumization

- Cooldown expired message toggle (Configurable in messages.yml)

- Support for custom sounds for successful and unsuccessful operations

- Support for particles around the player after using the /randomreward command

- Fully customizable particles

- There are 6 ready-made particle templates in the templates.yml file.

- Templates are fully customizable

**Permissions and Commands:**

/akrrwd reload - akrrwd.reload

/akrrwd reset <PlayerName> or All - akrrwd.reset

/akrrwd settime <PlayerName> - akrrwd.settime

/akrrwd toggle - Players have this permission by default

/akrrwd help - Players have this permission by default


**Commands description:**

/randomreward - Gives a random reward if cooldown has expired.

/akrrwd help - Shows this help message.

/akrrwd reload - Reloads the plugin configuration.

/akrrwd reset <player/all> - Resets cooldown for a player or all players.

/akrrwd settime <player> <days,hours,minutes,seconds> - Sets cooldown for a player.

/akrrwd toggle - Toggles the BossBar display.
